server.name: com.pulsemcp/gcs
server.description: MCP server for Google Cloud Storage with fine-grained tool access control.

environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud project ID.
environmentVariables.name: GCS_PROJECT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Path to service account key JSON file.
environmentVariables.name: GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Service account key JSON contents (inline).
environmentVariables.name: GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON

environmentVariables.description: Constrain all operations to a single bucket (hides bucket-level tools).
environmentVariables.name: GCS_BUCKET

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable (readonly, readwrite, delete).
environmentVariables.name: GCS_ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of specific tools to enable (overrides groups).
environmentVariables.name: GCS_ENABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of specific tools to disable.
environmentVariables.name: GCS_DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Skip health checks on startup.
environmentVariables.name: SKIP_HEALTH_CHECKS
